description: This file contains unit tests for AWS SQS streaming integration within Orleans, specifically testing client-side behavior including producer dropout scenarios. It defines a test class 'SQSClientStreamTests' with setup, configuration, and cleanup routines, as well as a test method 'SQSStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest'.

classes.name: SQSClientStreamTests
classes.description: A test class for SQS streaming functionality in Orleans, including setup, configuration, and cleanup routines, and specific tests for client dropout scenarios.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo builder to add SQS stream provider, memory storage, and messaging options.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client builder to add SQS stream provider.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous initialization method setting up the test runner.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with SQS provider and storage if SQS is available.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous cleanup disposing of test cluster and deleting used SQS queues if connection string is available.

methods.name: SQSStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test method verifying producer behavior upon client drop in SQS streaming.
